concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 vs spec.md:FR-003 and constitution Principle VI
concerns.text: T003 requires 'R² ≥ 0.95 AND log-log slope ≈ 1' as an acceptance gate, but spec FR-003 and Constitution VI both specify ONLY 'R² ≥ 0.95'. This is an unauthorized additional acceptance criterion that can reject trajectories the spec would accept (retroactive narrowing), and '≈ 1' has no defined tolerance, making the gate untestable as written. Either amend the spec/constitution or drop the second criterion.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T007 / plan.md Summary step 4 vs contracts/bootstrap_stats.schema.yaml
concerns.text: T007 (and plan step 4) specify recording null mean/CI with a granularity_note for conditions with zero accepted seeds, but the contract requires n_seeds as integer ≥ 1 and mae_1ns/mae_10ns as numbers ≥ 0 (non-nullable). Schema validation will fail exactly when the documented fallback is needed. The task as written cannot satisfy both its own failure-mode handling and the contract.

T006 flags 'variance > 5%' and the contract states variance_pct 'Must be < 5% per SC-002', but SC-002 does not exist in spec.md and the 5% threshold appears nowhere in spec or plan. An unverifiable success criterion is being enforced only at the contract/task layer without a spec anchor.

The note claims 'the active spec.md already reflects ... the descriptive paired-comparison wording', but the displayed spec.md FR-008/SC-005 still mandate a paired-bootstrap hypothesis test with a reported p-value. T007 does compute a p_value, so no actual weakening occurs in the task itself — but the justification for dropping the spec-edit tasks is factually false and should be corrected (the tasks satisfy the spec as-is; the note's rationale is wrong).

The sensitivity analysis (T006, sensitivity_report.json) traces to no FR in the spec — US2 cites FR-004 and FR-009, which are bootstrap timing and end-to-end execution. The plan itself admits 'SC-002 is absent from the original spec'. This is a scope addition without a spec amendment; either add an FR or explicitly document it as plan-added methodological rigor.

The Yeh-Hummer finite-size correction is implemented in T003 but appears nowhere in spec FR-002's definition of D. Scientifically defensible, but it is a plan-added transformation of a spec-defined quantity with no recorded justification in the spec — document it or amend the spec.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Inputs header vs actual artifact paths
concerns.text: The Inputs line and plan.md reference 'specs/001-investigating-md-diffusion-predictive-power/' while the active artifacts live under 'specs/001-investigating-the-predictive-power-of-mo/'. Path mismatch could break the schema-validation steps in T004/T006/T007 if implemented literally.
